name: Galxe
rootCause: On October 6, an unknown individual contacted our domain service provider Dynadot, impersonating an authorized Galxe member and bypassing the security process with falsified documentation. The impersonator then gained unauthorized access to the domain account, which was manipulated to redirect website visitors to a fake site and sign transactions that misappropriated their funds. On October 7, Galxe released a statement on the October 6 DNS security incident stating that the site is now fully restored, with an estimated 1,120 users affected and approximately $270,000 stolen. On October 11, Galxe announced a compensation plan for the security incident that occurred on October 6, 2023.…

On 6 October 2023, Galxe experienced a DNS hijacking attack that redirected users to a phishing site. Attackers stole approximately $270,000 from user wallets by tricking them into signing malicious transactions. Only the frontend was compromised; smart contracts remained secure. Galxe implemented user reimbursements and strengthened security controls. Attackers socially engineered domain registrar Dynadot, gained access to Galxe's DNS records using falsified documentation, and redirected galxe.com visitors to a phishing site that mimicked legitimate wallet requests. Users who approved transactions on the fake site lost funds to attacker-controlled addresses.
